maria: I'm opening a short docs PR for 'Orion-XL-LongCtx' model card. Quick sanity-check please — usable_context math, quant fallback note, and a tiny streaming SDK example.

maria: Draft SDK v3 snippet: ```from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RW_KEY")
with client.chat.stream(model="orion-xl-longctx") as s:
    s.call_function("summarize_sections")
    for ch in s:
        print(ch.text, end="")```

tom: looks good. add a one-line note that reported max_seq=8192 but safe usable_context ~= reported - 40.

kai: also note: 4-bit CPU fallback only supported with profile-lite. profile-compat will error.

jen: bench alignment: card currently shows seq=2048 but catalog index uses 1024. pick one or add appendix.

maria: I'll add a small appendix table (1024/2048/4096) and a short sentence about non-linear latency growth.

ci-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5510 by maria (draft) — checks queued.

docs-bot: left auto-review checklist: linkcheck, code-snippet lint.

maria: pushed the appendix and wording changes. Adding embed policy note: not available for embeddings; recommend Orion-Embed family.

jen: tiny nit: replace '4-bit CPU fallback' with '4-bit quantized CPU fallback (profile-lite only)'.

maria: updated. Waiting for CI then will merge unless anyone objects.

ci-bot: linkcheck found one broken link -> fixed by maria. All checks passed.

docs-bot: PR 5510 merged by maria — published to staging docs.

maria: thanks all. filing a follow-up issue to monitor truncation telemetry.
